1.2.1.2-f64.text: Usque ad lunam animas esse aethereas vocarique heroas, lares, genios

translations.note: In Varro (as quoted by Augustine, City of God 7.6) the souls above the moon are ethereal, and the souls between the moon and the clouds are aerial and are called heroes, lares and genii. Burton's note squeezes the two together, so the names seem to belong to the ethereal souls.
